title: Tooltip
description: A label that appears on hover and focus, in ink black. Pure CSS — no positioning library, no JS.
usage: For naming icon buttons and shortening explanations. Never for essential information — if it matters, write it on the page. Keep it under five words.
a11y: The trigger must be focusable so the tooltip appears on keyboard focus too. The tooltip text duplicates the accessible name; it never replaces it.
